hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Clean modern card UI with decent typographic hierarchy, but the edge bundle visualization defaults to Tableau10 colors with tangled hairball links at low tension, and the developer-facing FPS counter undermines the polished wrapper.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Correct scaleSqrt for force-layout node sizing, data-driven domains via d3.extent, key functions present in all data joins, and no quantitative baseline violations — this is a relational/categorical layout so bar-chart pitfalls don't apply; minor: the sunburst uses a sqrt radial rescale that compresses outer rings but is a documented design choice, not deception.
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: Tension slider fires synchronous redrawLinks() on every input event across 300+ paths with no RAF coalescing; layout switches create new svg.transition() without explicit .interrupt() (relying on D3 implicit preemption, leaving current_x/y unsynced if 'end' never fires); no touch event filtering on drag or click handlers risks double-trigger on mobile.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: Interaction design (hover/click fade) and color grouping manage 200 nodes well, but 300 bundled edges at default 8% tension form an unreadable central hairball, and 8 simultaneous layout modes plus a dense control panel push working memory near its limit without clear progressive disclosure.
